property_summary: For any non-empty _tos array and any callee contract, C.transfer either completes successfully only if every low-level transferFrom call to the callee succeeds; the mutant that ignores call return values can return true even when a callee call fails — therefore the reference always reverts when any sub-call reverts, while the mutant may not.
change_summary: Do not require success of each external call; instead ignore failures (remove require(_s);), so transfer can return true when original would revert.
